How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIIT Surat Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.iiitsurat.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Surat Junior Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the hard copy of the application form is 03 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Civil/Architect) with 60% marks and 5 years of experience, or a Three-year Diploma in Engineering with 60% marks and 8 years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Engineer post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 1000/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary as per Level – 6 of the 7th CPC, ranging from Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a full-time job?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a full-time job opportunity at IIIT Surat.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is IIITS/RNF/2026-27/02.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIIT Surat located?
faq.answer: IIIT Surat is located in Surat, Gujarat, with the pincode 394190.

faq.question: Q10. How can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of IIIT Surat, which is www.iiitsurat.ac.in.
